description: Derive mttr_days (closed_at - first_seen, in days) for findings that carry both timestamps, so the Findings-lifecycle dashboard can aggregate MTTR. This is a COLLECTOR/viewing-layer derivation computed at index time — the agent's Findings Engine emits only first_seen/last_seen/closed_at (rule: never store a field the engine doesn't own); mttr is derivable, so the collector computes it here rather than the engine persisting it. Set as the findings index's default_pipeline (see findings-index-template.json).
